note: PROPOSED World at War style numbers for the Zombies mode (open for the user, see docs/zombies/ZOMBIES-MODE.md). Round 1 sends a handful of slow zombies; health grows by 100 a round to round 9, then 10 percent a round; runners from round 3, sprinters from round 5. Points: 10 a hit, 60 a kill, 100 a headshot kill, 130 a melee kill, 10 a board.

perks.name: Juggernog
perks.blurb: Zombie hits do 40 percent of their damage.

perks.name: Second Wind
perks.blurb: When you go down, you get back up on your own after a few seconds (used up).

slots.note: PROPOSED slot machines (docs/zombies/ZOMBIES-MODE.md, Slot machines): a pull costs costBase + costPerRound a round after the first (at most costMax); the reels spin spinSeconds and the result shows showSeconds. The odds by round are DropTables.json slotTiers. Heat: every pull without a pityTier-or-better part adds 1, every heatStep heat moves the part odds one rarity up (at most heatMaxSteps), such a part resets it. At most maxNothing nothing-results in a row per player per machine. Every jackpotEvery-th round adds jackpotLegendary / jackpotWonder to the odds and puts the wonder symbol on the reels.

powerUps.note: World at War style power-ups (milestone 3; Infinite Ammo and the weights 2026-10-23). A kill drops one with dropChance, at most maxPerRound a round; it floats for lifetime seconds (blinking for the last blinkSeconds). The timed ones (Insta-Kill, Double Points, Infinite Ammo) last their durations entry, or duration seconds. Max Ammo is the most common drop (about 38 percent).

ammoEffects.note: PROPOSED (milestone 3): what part flags do to zombies (docs/zombies/ZOMBIES-MODE.md, Special ammo effects). One effect of each kind per shot or swing, never stacked.
